title: Synthesis and molecular structure of a tetrameric neodymium-silsesquioxane cage complex: {[(i-C4H9)7(Si7O12)Nd]4NaCl}

synthesis.procedure: All operations were carried out under argon using Schlenk techniques. NaOiPr (97 mg, 1.18 mmol) in 4 mL of hot benzene/iPrOH (v/v = 1:1) was added into a refluxing iPrOH solution of NdCl3 (95 mg, 0.38 mmol, in 4 mL of iPrOH), and the mixture was refluxed overnight. The precipitate was removed by centrifugation and the clear blue solution was evaporated in vacuo to a pale blue residue, which was extracted with 7 mL of toluene. [(i-C4H9)7(Si7O9)(OH)3] (292 mg, 0.37 mmol) was added to the toluene extract and the mixture was stirred at 70 °C for 12 h. The solvent was removed in vacuo, the pale blue residue was extracted with 7 mL of hexane, and the extract was concentrated to about 2 mL and cooled to −30 °C to give pale blue crystals of 1.

reagents.name: neodymium(III) chloride
reagents.amount: 95 mg, 0.38 mmol, in 4 mL of iPrOH

synthesis.temperature: reflux overnight (NdCl3/NaOiPr in iPrOH); 70 °C for the silsesquioxane step; crystallization at −30 °C
synthesis.vessel_or_method: Schlenk techniques under argon; centrifugation to remove precipitate
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Evaporation of the blue solution, toluene extraction, solvent removal, hexane extraction, concentration to ~2 mL, and cooling to −30 °C afforded pale blue crystals.
